root_cause.text: The spin lock `bcm_tx_lock` was only initialized in `bcm_tx_setup()` but not in `bcm_rx_setup()`, even though RX bcm_ops can also transmit CAN frames when the `RX_RTR_FRAME` flag is set, leading to an uninitialized lock and potential corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `spin_lock_init(&op->bcm_tx_lock);` in `bcm_rx_setup()`, and the CVE description explicitly states that the lock was "only initialized in bcm_tx_setup()" and the fix is to "Add the missing spin_lock_init() when allocating the bcm_op in bcm_rx_setup() to handle the RTR case properly."
